types.description: NH00 gG fuse link / 160 A / front indicator / live grip lugs

document.title: Siemens Data sheet 3NA3836
document.pages: 1-2 technical data; 3 dimensional drawing; 4 circuit diagram

modelingNotes: Bare NH00 gG fuse link, 160 A; capability 500 V AC / 250 V DC. No assigned nominal circuit voltage or AC-only metadata.

Rated AC current is 160 A. Operational-current table: 156.8 A at 30 °C; 152 A at 40 °C; 147.2 A at 45 °C; 144 A at 50 °C; 140.8 A at 55 °C; 137.6 A at 60 °C. Separately specified operating ambient is -5 to +40 °C. No unconditional scalar current rating is assigned.
Keys 1 and 2 preserve manufacturer circuit-diagram identifiers on datasheet p.4, not verified physical stamping, polarity or mounting orientation.

Front indication is non-terminal hardware. Live grip lugs are handling hardware, not external wiring terminals or protective earth. Fuse base and accessory signal detectors are not part of this order.
Closed contact with fuse mark represents the intact protective element only; it creates no permanent net continuity and does not simulate fuse clearing or coordination.
Manufacturer-authored datasheet retained at a distributor mirror; dimensional and circuit drawings visually reviewed.

connectionCoverage.notes: Two external blade-contact circuit endpoints 1 and 2, as drawn on exact-order datasheet p.4. Front indicator and live handling lugs add no wiring terminals. Bare link only; no fuse base or accessory contacts.
